items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Bill Gillan was a very fine, very fine trumpet player... we used to kid him to the extent that we used to call him Bix sometimes... I don't think I've seen him probably ten years or so.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you something about that trumpet player that was playing in front of you, Bill Gillan? Bill Gillan?

Bill Gillan was a very fine, very fine trumpet player. Played very, very good, uh, lead trumpet. Um, I think, uh, Bill, Bill, uh, would have been a really, a real fine, all-around, New Orleans man. Uh, of course, he gave it up. I don't know, he hasn't played for quite some time now. In fact, I don't think I've seen him probably ten years or so. Uh, Bill, Bill used to like Bix quite a lot in those days. Uh, in fact, he, uh, he imitated some of his solos quite well. And, uh, we used to kid him to the extent that we…
When did he, uh, die? I mean, when did he stop playing?
